% A document written for pdflatex that uses the name of a form, read with
% \pdfxformname after \pdfxform, as a number: assigned to a count register
% with \count@=, \advance, and \setcounter, in a \numexpr, after \number,
% \ifnum, \ifcase, and \romannumeral, in the text, in italic, sans-serif,
% and typewriter text, a footnote, a theorem, and a heading written to the
% table of contents, read in an \edef, an \xdef, and a \csname, given
% \pdflastxform, a count register, an explicit number, or a macro, and
% followed by a digit or \relax, after a \pdfxform with \immediate, attr,
% and resources, after an image, and in a group. \pdflastxform is read
% with \the, saved with \the in an \xdef, and followed by a digit. In the
% PDF the name is the form's number, 1 for the first form, 2 for the
% second, 3 for the third, and 4 for the one made in a group.
% \pdflastxform is the form's object number, which tex8web does not know:
% the page shows the form's number in its place, which is the object
% number when no image or other object comes before the form (the PDF
% shows 7 at Object, after an image).
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newcounter{fm}
\newcount\formno
\def\formtwo{2}
\expandafter\def\csname Fm1\endcsname{one}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\setbox2\hbox{x}\pdfxform2 \formno=\pdflastxform
\xdef\savedform{\the\pdflastxform}

\section{Head \pdfxformname\pdflastxform{} and \number\numexpr\pdfxformname\pdflastxform+1\relax{} end}

\makeatletter
\count@=\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax
Count: [\the\count@] end.

\advance\count@ by \pdfxformname\pdflastxform 5\relax
Advance: [\the\count@] end.

Last digit: [\count@=\pdflastxform 5\relax\the\count@] end.
\makeatother

\setcounter{fm}{\pdfxformname\pdflastxform}%
Setcounter: [\thefm] end.

Numexpr: [\the\numexpr\pdfxformname\pdflastxform*10+3\relax] end.

Number: [\number\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Ifnum: [\ifnum\pdfxformname\pdflastxform>0 pos\else zero\fi] end.

Ifcase: [\ifcase\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax zero\or one\or two\fi] end.

Roman: [\romannumeral\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax] end.

\edef\formedef{\pdfxformname\pdflastxform}%
Edef: [\formedef] end.

{\xdef\formxdef{\pdfxformname\pdflastxform}}%
Xdef: [\formxdef] end.

Csname: [\csname Fm\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\endcsname] end.

Text: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Italic: \emph{a[\number\pdfxformname\pdflastxform]b end}.

Sans: \textsf{c[\ifnum\pdfxformname\pdflastxform=1 first\else other\fi]d end}.

Typewriter: \texttt{e[\pdfxformname\pdflastxform]f end}.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note [\the\numexpr\pdfxformname\pdflastxform+1\relax] end.} after.

\begin{theorem}
Theorem [\ifnum\pdfxformname\pdflastxform=1 one\else other\fi] end.
\end{theorem}

\setbox2\hbox{y}\immediate\pdfxform attr{/Foo 1} resources{/Bar 2} 2

Second: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Second ifnum: [\ifnum\pdfxformname\pdflastxform>1 second\else first\fi] end.

Saved count: [\pdfxformname\formno] end.

Saved the: [\pdfxformname\savedform] end.

Explicit: [\pdfxformname 2 ] end.

Macro: [\pdfxformname\formtwo] end.

Digit: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform 5] end.

Relax: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax] end.

\immediate\pdfximage{test-picture.png}%
\setbox2\hbox{z}\pdfxform2

After image: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Object: [\the\pdflastxform] end.

{\setbox2\hbox{g}\pdfxform2}Group: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.
\end{document}
